body: Windows node window (hall9k-ce), 15:5x EDT: v0.10.2 installed. h9k update --restart at 15:44:41 EDT, stopped pid 36732, started pid 37128, h9k --version 0.10.2, catch-up adopted 4 runs, 0 orphaned, no .new recipes, ledger-no-key warnings for the three unjoined projects unchanged. Incident, mine: the restart landed two minutes into a56cf16e's test gate (the daemon's own dotnet test); the orphaned test tree locked verify-test.log and the resumed pipeline crashed on it every 5 s until I killed the orphan tree at 15:46 EDT; the gate then re-ran from the start under the new daemon (phase gate test, running). 5c46cd1d unaffected. Node rule refined: a run in phase gate test blocks a restart.
